title: Account-Standing Schedule for the Combined-Program Credit
content:
**Schedule.** For a tuition-based Pre-K child of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the combined-program credit is reduced when the tuition account is in arrears on the day the credit is posted.

The whole months of arrears are the enrollment's tuition charges and late fees less its payments, divided by the most recent billing month's tuition charge and rounded down to a whole number. Credits are not payments and are not subtracted.

| Whole months of arrears on the day the credit is posted | Taken off the credit |
|---|---|
| three or more | 15.00 |
| two | 7.50 |
| one or none | nothing |

## Worked cases (hypothetical enrollment, most recent tuition charge 400.00)

| Charges and late fees to date | Payments to date | Credits to date | Arrears divided by 400.00 | Whole months | Taken off |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2,050.00 | 850.00 | 0.00 | 3.0 | 3 | 15.00 |
| 2,050.00 | 1,000.00 | 300.00 | 2.625 | 2 | 7.50 (the credits are not subtracted) |
| 2,050.00 | 1,300.00 | 0.00 | 1.875 | 1 | nothing |
